models.title: Models
models.empty: No run results were found in {dir}.
models.f1_included_title: Macro F1 excluding the labels in exclude_labels.
models.mixup_title: Trained on {mixes} synthetic audio mixes and {real} real training windows.

metrics.excluded_row: Listed in exclude_labels: excluded from the model output and from the included average.
metrics.empty_embeddings: This is an embeddings run. No classifier was trained, so no metrics are available. The projection is shown on the Map tab.
metrics.empty_dataset: This is a dataset export. No embeddings or classifier were produced.
metrics.empty_none: No evaluation table is available: this run did not write per-class metrics.
metrics.mix_note: The Real training, In mixes and Mix share columns describe the data each class was trained on. Scores and Samples are computed on real test windows only. Hover over an In mixes value to see which classes it was mixed with.
metrics.mixed_title: Synthetic mixed test set ({count} mixes of test windows)
metrics.mixed_note: Evaluated separately from the real test set. Classes that appear in no mix are greyed out and excluded from the averages.
metrics.mixed_absent_row: This class appears in no mix and is excluded from the averages. It was predicted in {fp} mixes (false positives at its threshold).

map.note_row_order: Sample keys were inferred from row order, because this projection predates the key column.
map.note_none: No sample keys are available, so points cannot be linked to their audio.
map.clip_noise: mixed with noise file {noise} at {snr} dB SNR
map.clip_noise_missing: (noise file {noise} not found; playing the clean window)
